input: Fresh R3 solved graph labels only; exact graph IDs, hard sets and freshly computed mm fields
outside_graph: Explicit unassigned/nonparticipating status; separate independent reference buckets only
component_order: THUMB then INDEX; components visited by ascending minimum vertex ID and sorted neighbors
component_action: Only components without any own-digit hard source may reassign to opposite label; verify both hard sets after every update
full_sweep_changed: Initialize sweep_changed=False once before both target loops; OR every target change into it, never reset per target
convergence: A complete THUMB+INDEX sweep with zero changes; confirm pin preservation before success
cycle_detection: Hash sorted (vertex_id,label) after each changed full sweep; repeated state fails closed
non_convergent: FAIL_CLOSED on repeated state or cap reached while still changing; do not publish the latest labels as valid
